title: Metal Measurement Source CSV Mapping v0.1

artifact_relative_path.description: Exact manifest-declared relative artifact path; must match the CLI argument.

source_row_id_header.description: Exact source header containing stable source-native row identity; row ordinals are not substituted.

canonical_field_id.description: Explicit stable field identity supplied by the profile author; never inferred from display text.

raw_unit.description: Explicit source unit or declared non-numeric type label; this tool does not infer unit semantics.

missing_policy.description: Choose whether an empty mapped cell fails reconciliation or is counted explicitly as missing. No imputation is performed.

value_kind.description: Explicit lexical validator; numeric fields must parse as finite IEEE-754 values.

missing_tokens.description: Exact, case-sensitive source tokens treated as missing; blank cells are missing separately. Do not guess sentinel values.

excluded_columns.description: Every source header other than source_row_id_header and mapped columns must be explicitly excluded with a reviewable reason.

reason.description: Why the source column is excluded from this profile; the source bytes remain bound in the artifact digest.
